title: I haven't really slept before this launch, am I okay

messages.content: ok so i haven't really slept before this launch am i okay
It sounds like you're pushing yourself to the limit, Elon. Sleep is crucial, especially before something as significant as a launch. How are you feeling right now?
wired and hollow. like a buzzing drone but with a battery warning.
That mix of energy and exhaustion can be challenging. Your body needs rest to function optimally. Is there any way you could take even a short nap before things ramp up? It might help you recharge.
can't really nap. too much to do. gotta make sure the Leviathan doesn't become a giant lawn dart.

The pressure you're under is immense, but you're also a valuable part of this process. Taking care of yourself now ensures you're at your best when it matters most. Could Priya Chen or Dr. Renata Voss handle some tasks while you rest?
mimi and priya both worried. priya left gentle reminders like it's a new art form.

They care about you and want what's best. It's a testament to the support network you've built. Perhaps sharing how you feel with them could help. They might offer ideas for delegating responsibilities, even temporarily.
spacey's attempt is my big shot. can't mess it up by dozing off at a console.

I understand the desire for everything to go perfectly, but your presence at the console will be most effective if you're sharp and clear-headed. Even a brief pause to rest can improve your focus when you're back, ensuring the launch goes smoothly.
what if i just chug more coffee instead of sleeping?

Caffeine can offer a temporary boost, but it's not a substitute for real rest. Over-relying on it could heighten the 'wired and hollow' feeling without addressing your body's need for recuperation. Balancing both may be key right now.
maybe i'll sneak in a power nap later. after the important stuff.

That sounds like a reasonable plan. Even a short nap can help restore some mental clarity. Just remember, your well-being is crucial for both you and SpaceY's objectives. Everyone on your team is rooting for both the launch and for you.
